title: Warrant body
description: A Court's warrant to open a class of private data for the inspectorate (register row DK1744, from IS9; spec-delta S1603; docs/institutions/inspectorate.md 3): signed by the Courts, requested by the inspectorate, granted by more than half of a panel of at least three jurors none of whom is the subject or its sponsor, for at most 72 hours, with grounds and a scope in words. Key material is never available (warrant_key_material); a sealed memory is opened only by the principal producing the extract (`produced_by` is the sponsor: warrant_sealed_not_by_principal). The sponsor is told within an hour of the grant unless the Court found that notice would defeat the investigation (`delayed_notice_finding`), and never later than 72 hours. The log applies the rules of packages/asp-log/src/inspectorate.ts (warrant_wrong_issuer, warrant_wrong_requester, warrant_unknown_agent, warrant_sponsor_mismatch, warrant_party_on_panel, warrant_invalid). Chain: none (prev is null).
